scale_att1: Scaling ATK
Energy Cost: 50
Cooldown: 13.5s
"When taking action, no matter how fast your heart is pounding, you've gotta keep a cool head... Huh? Fighting? No, I'm talking about making machines!"
Precision Hydronic Cooler is Aino 's Elemental Burst .

- Water balls are fired every 1.5 seconds and up to 9 can be fired during the skill's duration. With Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam, water balls are fired every 0.75 seconds and up to 20 can be fired during the skill's duration.
- With Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam, water balls are fired every 0.75 seconds and up to 20 can be fired during the skill's duration.
Passive Effects:

- Passive Talent 1, Modular Efficiency Protocol : "Aino will be granted the corresponding buff effects based on the party 's Moonsign. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam : Her Elemental Burst Precision Hydronic Cooler is enhanced: The Cool Your Jets Ducky will fire water balls more frequently, and the water balls will deal AoE Hydro DMG over a larger area of effect."
Constellation Effects:

- Constellation Level 1, The Theory of Ash—Field Equilibrium : "After Aino uses her Elemental Skill Musecatcher or her Elemental Burst Precision Hydronic Cooler , her Elemental Mastery will be increased by 80. The Elemental Mastery of other nearby active party members will be increased by 80 for 15s. The Elemental Mastery-increasing effects of this Constellation do not stack."
- Constellation Level 2, The Principle of Transference in Gear Differentials : "If Aino is off-field while the Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone of her Elemental Burst Precision Hydronic Cooler is active, when your active party member hits a nearby opponent with an attack, the Cool Your Jets Ducky will fire an additional water ball at that opponent, dealing AoE Hydro DMG equal to 25% of Aino's ATK and 100% of her Elemental Mastery . This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 5s."
- Constellation Level 3, Cake and the Art of Mechanism Repair : Increases this talent's level by 3, up to a maximum of 15.
- Constellation Level 6, The Burden of Creative Genius : "For the next 15s after using the Elemental Burst Precision Hydronic Cooler , DMG from nearby active characters' Electro-Charged , Bloom , Lunar-Charged , Lunar-Bloom , and Lunar-Crystallize reactions is increased by 15%. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam : DMG from the aforementioned reactions will be further increased by 20%."

Solo Dance Double: A psychic double of Odette's that dances a duet with her. May be summoned to the field through her Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst. Alternates between the Plume and Wing dance moves to periodically attack nearby opponents, dealing AoE Cryo DMG . A maximum of one Solo Dance Double summoned by Odette is allowed on the field at any one time. Additionally, when there is a Dance Double summoned by Odette nearby, her Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers is changed to the special Elemental Skill Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling.
Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling: Odette's special Elemental Skill, which deals to nearby opponents AoE Cryo DMG over time. Then, when the dance duel ends, she deals another instance of AoE Cryo DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct DMG. During the dance duet, Odette can control the direction of the dance steps. Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The DMG dealt when the dance duet ends is changed to AoE Cryo DMG of the corresponding Stellar reaction type. Additionally, after Odette unleashes the special Elemental Skill Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling, should she be in the Radiance: Stellar Glimmer state while her Dance Double is still on the field, the Dance Double's two dance move types will also deal additional AoE Cryo DMG of the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction type.

Banehunter Oathhammer: A witchhunter's trusty companion! Under the right conditions, the Banehunter Oathhammer undergoes Elemental Conversion, turning all its DMG into DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type. Prune can summon the Banehunter Oathhammer that has undergone Elemental Conversion in the following ways: For a certain time after triggering a Swirl Reaction on an opponent with the Elemental Skill Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime, Prune can unleash the special Elemental Skill Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes!. When using this special Elemental Skill, the Banehunter Oathhammer will be converted to the other Elemental Type involved in the aforementioned Swirl Reaction. After the Ascension Talent "Verdict and Punishment" is unlocked, when the Witchlure Bell in Hunter-Seeker mode triggers Swirl on an opponent, it will summon a Banehunter Oathhammer that has undergone the corresponding Elemental Conversion to attack the opponent.

Windborne Sword: When in the Armed for Action mode, Vesna can consume Sword Essence to use her special Elemental Skill to deal Anemo DMG . Each use of the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword in the same instance of Armed for Action will increase the level of Windborne Sword, beginning from Lv. 1, up to Lv. 3 max. Using Windborne Sword at Lv. 2 and Lv. 3 will also summon a Spirit Blade which deals Anemo DMG .
For the Tsaritsa!: Summons multiple Spirit Blades, dealing AoE Anemo DMG . Also gains a stack of Sword Essence.
Spirit Blade: A weapon with special power that Vesna can summon. Attacks the opponent alongside Vesna to deal Anemo DMG . Vesna can summon Spirit Blades through the following ways: By unleashing the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword at Lv. 2 and Lv. 3; By using the Elemental Burst For the Tsaritsa!; or By using Windborne Sword·: Transpose in the Constellation Unwavering Ardor. Radiance: Stellar Swirl: DMG dealt by the Spirit Blades become Anemo DMG that is considered Stellar Swirl reaction DMG instead.

heading_path: Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon
pairs: Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon

Let the wishes of all beings become as moonlight that bathes the earth. Lauma incants a sacred song of the far north, gaining 18 stacks of Pale Hymn . Additionally, if Lauma uses her Elemental Burst while she has Moon Song , or she gains Moon Song within 15s of using her Elemental Burst, she will consume all Moon Song stacks and gain 6 stacks of Pale Hymn for every Moon Song stack consumed. This effect can only be triggered once for each Elemental Burst used, including the 15 seconds following its use. Pale Hymn When nearby party members deal Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, or Lunar-Bloom DMG, 1 stack of Pale Hymn will be consumed and the DMG dealt will be increased based on Lauma's Elemental Mastery . If this DMG hits multiple opponents at once, then multiple stacks of Pale Hymn will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit. The duration for each stack of Pale Hymn is counted independently.

blocks.text:
Pale Hymn: A hymn passed down by generations of Moonchanters that increases the DMG dealt by Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, and Lunar-Bloom reactions. Lauma can gain Pale Hymn stacks in the following ways: When using her Elemental Burst Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon. When consuming Moon Song stacks due to using her Elemental Burst Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon. When the Frostgrove Sanctuary triggers the effect of her Constellation "I Offer Blood and Tears to the Moonlight". When party members deal Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, or Lunar-Bloom DMG, 1 stack of Pale Hymn will be consumed and the DMG dealt will be increased based on Lauma's Elemental Mastery. If this DMG hits multiple opponents at once, then multiple stacks of Pale Hymn will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit. The duration for each stack of Pale Hymn is counted independently.
Moon Song: A melody used to weave together hymns. When an Elemental Burst is used, or for a period of time after an Elemental Burst has been used, it can be converted into Pale Hymn stacks that increase the DMG from Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, and Lunar-Bloom reactions. When Lauma consumes Verdant Dew to perform the Hold version of her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko, each Verdant Dew consumed will provide Lauma with 1 stack of Moon Song.

pairs: Silently incants an ancient hymn, summoning a Frostgrove Sanctuary with different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold. Tap Intone a Hymn of Hunting, dealing AoE Dendro DMG . Hold Can be unleashed when you have at least 1 Verdant Dew . Lauma consumes all Verdant Dew and intones a Hymn of Eternal Rest, dealing one regular instance of AoE Dendro DMG and another instance of AoE Dendro DMG that is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Each Verdant Dew consumed will give Lauma one stack of Moon Song . Each time you Hold to cast an Elemental Skill, a maximum of 3 Verdant Dew can be consumed in this way. Additionally, when Lauma's Elemental Skill or attacks from Frostgrove Sanctuary hit an opponent, that opponent's Dendro RES and Hydro RES will be decreased for 10s.

Name: Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko
Character: Lauma
Talent Type: Elemental Skill
Category: Combat
Description: Silently incants an ancient hymn, summoning a Frostgrove Sanctuary with different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold. Tap Intone a Hymn of Hunting, dealing AoE Dendro DMG . Hold Can be unleashed when you have at least 1 Verdant Dew . Lauma consumes all Verdant Dew and intones a Hymn of Eternal Rest, dealing one regular instance of AoE Dendro DMG and another instance of AoE Dendro DMG that is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Each Verdant Dew consumed will give Lauma one stack of Moon Song . Each time you Hold to cast an Elemental Skill, a maximum of 3 Verdant Dew can be consumed in this way. Additionally, when Lauma's Elemental Skill or attacks from Frostgrove Sanctuary hit an opponent, that opponent's Dendro RES and Hydro RES will be decreased for 10s.

utility1: Utility Direct Lunar-Bloom Dendro RES Reduction Hydro RES Reduction
Cooldown: 12s

The sagas of the scions of the far north tell of how the apostle of the golden city and the emissary of the gods once used the "primordial tongue" to shape the forms of all mortal things. Thus were the hymns known as Runo — imbued with power and sacred authority — established as the very foundation of magic. Though the words of those first incantations are now lost to time, their melodies — and the memories woven within them — have been passed down, and the powers they awaken, though faint, remain capable of stirring change.
Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko is Lauma 's Elemental Skill .

- When Frostgrove Sanctuary hits at least one enemy , it generates 1.3 Elemental Particles . This particle generation has a cooldown of 3.3 seconds.
- This particle generation has a cooldown of 3.3 seconds.
Passive Effects:

- Passive Talent 1, Light for the Frosty Night : "For the next 20s after Lauma uses her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko , corresponding differing buff effects will be granted depending on the party 's Moonsign. The buffs provided by different Moonsign levels cannot stack. Moonsign: Nascent Gleam Bloom , Hyperbloom , and Burgeon DMG dealt by all nearby party members can score CRIT Hits , with CRIT Rate fixed at 15%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. CRIT Rate from this effect stacks with CRIT Rate from similar effects that allow these Elemental Reactions to CRIT. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG CRIT Rate +10%, CRIT DMG +20%."
Constellation Effects:

- Constellation Level 1, "O Lips, Weave Me Songs and Psalms" : "After Lauma uses her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko or her Elemental Burst Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon , she will gain Threads of Life for 20s. During this time, when nearby party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, nearby active characters will recover HP equal to 500% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery . This effect can be triggered once every 1.9s. Additionally, the Stamina cost for Lauma's Spirit Envoy Form will be reduced by 40%, and its Max Duration will be extended by 5s."
- Constellation Level 4, "Nor Yearn for the Great Bear's Might" : "When attacks from the Frostgrove Sanctuary summoned by her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko hit opponents, Lauma will regain 4 Elemental Energy . This effect can be triggered once every 5s."
- Constellation Level 5, "If Truth May Be Subject to Witness" : Increases this talent's level by 3, up to a maximum of 15.
- Constellation Level 6, "I Offer Blood and Tears to the Moonlight" : "When the Frostgrove Sanctuary attacks opponents, it will deal 1 additional instance of AOE Dendro DMG equal to 185% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery . This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. This instance of DMG will not consume any Pale Hymn stacks and will provide Lauma with 2 stacks of Pale Hymn, as well as refreshing the duration of Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner. This effect can occur up to 8 times during each Frostgrove Sanctuary. When using the Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko , all Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner will be removed. Additionally, when Lauma uses a Normal Attack while she has Pale Hymn stacks, she will consume 1 stack to convert this to deal Dendro DMG equal to 150% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam : All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG is elevated by 25%."

Frostgrove Sanctuary: A magical array that protects the Moonchanters and can be summoned by using the Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko. The Frostgrove Sanctuary will follow the active character, dealing a single instance of AoE Dendro DMG to opponents within the array every 2s. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
Verdant Dew: When party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, the party will receive such a resource. Your party will receive 1 Verdant Dew every 2.5s for 2.5s after triggering a Lunar-Bloom reaction. Your party can have up to 3 Verdant Dew. If you trigger another Lunar-Bloom reaction during this time, the duration of this effect will be reset.
Moon Song: A melody used to weave together hymns. When an Elemental Burst is used, or for a period of time after an Elemental Burst has been used, it can be converted into Pale Hymn stacks that increase the DMG from Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, and Lunar-Bloom reactions. When Lauma consumes Verdant Dew to perform the Hold version of her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko, each Verdant Dew consumed will provide Lauma with 1 stack of Moon Song.
Elevation: Special DMG Boost effect. It is calculated independently of other DMG Boost effects.

pairs: Jahoda dashes toward her opponent, entering the Shadow Pursuit state upon contact. While in this state, Jahoda moves continuously and swiftly: If nearby opponents are affected by Pyro , Hydro , Electro , or Cryo , she will quietly convert her Purr-loined Treasure Flask to that element, gradually filling it. When the duration ends or the skill is used again, Jahoda drains the Purr-loined Treasure Flask and deals a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. When the Purr-loined Treasure Flask is full, Jahoda immediately drains it, exiting the Shadow Pursuit state and dealing a more powerful instance of Anemo DMG . There are many ways to divide wealth in this world — but for Nod-Krai's treasure hunters — and hoarders — only one has ever proven sufficiently effective.
Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils is Jahoda 's Elemental Skill .

- When the filled or unfilled Purr-loined Treasure Flask hits at least one enemy , it generates 4 Elemental Particles .
- Jahoda needs to be at least 4m close to the element-affected enemy to be able to fill the Purr-loined Treasure Flask.
- The Purr-loined Treasure Flask is quarter-filled every 0.5s , and draining it takes another 0.5s . Therefore, Jahoda needs 2.5s to fill the flask.
- Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: The full Purr-loined Treasure Flask has 10 charges of Fluffy Meowballs, periodically firing every 2 second.
- Fluffy Meowball DMG has no Internal Cooldown .
Constellation Effects:

- Constellation Level 1, One More Flask! : "When a Fluffy Meowball fired by the Purr-loined Treasure Flask from the Elemental Skill Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils hits an enemy, there is a 50% chance for it to bounce, dealing the corresponding Elemental DMG to nearby opponents."
- Constellation Level 5, The Greatest Treasure : Increases this talent's level by 3, up to a maximum of 15.
- Constellation Level 6, The Littlest Luck : " Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam : After the Purr-loined Treasure Flask from the Elemental Skill Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils is full, nearby Moonsign characters in your party have their CRIT Rate increased by 5% and CRIT DMG increased by 40% for 20s."

Purr-loined Treasure Flask: A small elemental vessel that Jahoda retrieves after casting her Elemental Skill Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils. While Jahoda is in the Shadow Pursuit state, if nearby opponents are affected by Pyro , Hydro , Electro , or Cryo , the Purr-loined Treasure Flask will convert to that element and begin filling up. When the Purr-loined Treasure Flask is full, Jahoda immediately drains it, exiting the Shadow Pursuit state and dealing a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. pairs: Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights

A dance that dissolved dynasties, as chilling as a winter's night on the great sea of sand, yet lingering with the tenderness of moonlit gauze. Nefer charges forward, dealing AoE Dendro DMG and entering the Shadow Dance state. While in the Shadow Dance state, if you have at least 1 Verdant Dew , Nefer's Charged Attacks will be replaced with the special Charged Attack Phantasm Performance , which will not consume Stamina . When in the Shadow Dance state, Nefer's resistance to interruption is increased. Two initial charges.

blocks.text: - Passive Talent 1, A Wager of Moonlight : "Nefer will be granted the corresponding buff effects based on the party 's Moonsign. blocks.text:
Shadow Dance: After using the Elemental Skill Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights, Nefer will enter this state. While in the Shadow Dance state, if you have at least 1 Verdant Dew, Nefer's Charged Attacks will be replaced with the special Charged Attack Phantasm Performance. Nefer will exit the Shadow Dance state when she unleashes 3 Phantasm Performance(s) or the state's duration ends.
Verdant Dew: When party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, the party will receive such a resource. Your party will receive 1 Verdant Dew every 2.5s for 2.5s after triggering a Lunar-Bloom reaction. Your party can have up to 3 Verdant Dew. If you trigger another Lunar-Bloom reaction during this time, the duration of this effect will be reset.
Phantasm Performance: When in the Shadow Dance state caused by her Elemental Skill Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights, if you have at least 1 Verdant Dew, Nefer's Charged Attacks will be replaced with the special Charged Attack Phantasm Performance, which will not consume Stamina. Nefer summons shades of herself to perform Coordinated Attacks against enemies. Nefer and the shades will deal 2 and 3 stages of AoE Dendro DMG respectively. DMG dealt by the shades is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. 1 Verdant Dew will be consumed the first time shades are summoned after every Phantasm Performance.
Veil of Falsehood: After absorbing Seeds of Deceit via the Ascension Talent A Wager of Moonlight, Nefer gains this effect, thereby increasing the DMG dealt by her Phantasm Performance. Each stack of Veil of Falsehood increases the DMG dealt by Nefer's Phantasm Performance by 8%. The initial maximum number of stacks is 3, with each stack lasting for 9s (each stack's duration is counted independently).

pairs: Light the lamp, dealing AoE Geo DMG , and gain Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect for 20s. When this effect is active, Illuga gains 21 stacks of Nightingale's Song . When Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts of nearby active party members deal Geo DMG to opponents, 1 stack of Nightingale’s Song is consumed to increase the DMG dealt. Increase in DMG is based on Illuga’s Elemental Mastery. If DMG is inflicted by Lunar-Crystallize , DMG dealt will increase further. When Geo DMG dealt in this manner hits multiple opponents, multiple stacks of Nightingale's Song will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit. Additionally, if there are Geo Constructs created by nearby party members on the battlefield while Illuga unleashes his Elemental Burst, or when nearby party members create Geo Constructs while Haunted Night's Oriole-Song is active, every Geo Construct on the battlefield will allow Illuga to gain 5 additional stacks of Nightingale's Song. Within 20s after unleashing his Elemental Burst, Illuga can gain a maximum of 15 additional stacks of Nightingale’s Song this way. When all stacks of Nightingale's Song have been consumed, or when the state's duration ends, the Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect will end.

blocks.text:
Solo Dance Double: A psychic double of Odette's that dances a duet with her. May be summoned to the field through her Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst. Alternates between the Plume and Wing dance moves to periodically attack nearby opponents, dealing AoE Cryo DMG . A maximum of one Solo Dance Double summoned by Odette is allowed on the field at any one time. Additionally, when there is a Dance Double summoned by Odette nearby, her Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers is changed to the special Elemental Skill Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling.
Marvelous Splendor: After unlocking the Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One," Odette will obtain a special effect when she summons her Solo Dance Double. Every stack of Marvelous Splendor active increases the character's Stellar Glimmer DMG by 15%. This lasts until her Dance Double exits the field or when she summons her Solo Dance Double again. When Odette is off-field, she loses 1 stack of Marvelous Splendor every second, while other nearby party members gain the corresponding number of Marvelous Splendor stacks at the same time.

Shadow Dance: After using the Elemental Skill Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights, Nefer will enter this state. While in the Shadow Dance state, if you have at least 1 Verdant Dew, Nefer's Charged Attacks will be replaced with the special Charged Attack Phantasm Performance. Nefer will exit the Shadow Dance state when she unleashes 3 Phantasm Performance(s) or the state's duration ends.
Verdant Dew: When party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, the party will receive such a resource. Your party will receive 1 Verdant Dew every 2.5s for 2.5s after triggering a Lunar-Bloom reaction. Your party can have up to 3 Verdant Dew. If you trigger another Lunar-Bloom reaction during this time, the duration of this effect will be reset.

Armed for Action: Vesna switches to this mode after using the Elemental Skill The Art of Victory. In this mode, which lasts up to 15s: Vesna's resistance to interruption is increased. DMG dealt by Vesna with her Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks becomes Anemo DMG that cannot be overridden by another elemental infusion instead. She will also summon a wind pinion that attacks the opponent at the same time, dealing additional Anemo DMG . Each time the wind pinion is summoned, Vesna will regenerate a certain amount of Sword Essence. Vesna can consume Sword Essence to unleash the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword, which deals Anemo DMG to her opponents. Vesna will exit the mode when its duration ends or after she has used Windborne Sword at the highest level 3 times. Exiting will clear all remaining Sword Essence she has accrued.
Sword Essence: The energy required to use the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword while in the Armed for Action mode. Vesna can accumulate Sword Essence in the following ways: By performing a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, or Plunging attack while in the Armed for Action mode, or by unleashing Windborne Sword: Transpose from the Constellation Unwavering Ardor; By using the Elemental Skill The Art of Victory; or By using the Elemental Burst For the Tsaritsa!
Windborne Sword: When in the Armed for Action mode, Vesna can consume Sword Essence to use her special Elemental Skill to deal Anemo DMG . Each use of the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword in the same instance of Armed for Action will increase the level of Windborne Sword, beginning from Lv. 1, up to Lv. 3 max. Using Windborne Sword at Lv. 2 and Lv. 3 will also summon a Spirit Blade which deals Anemo DMG .
Spirit Blade: A weapon with special power that Vesna can summon. Attacks the opponent alongside Vesna to deal Anemo DMG . Vesna can summon Spirit Blades through the following ways: By unleashing the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword at Lv. 2 and Lv. 3; By using the Elemental Burst For the Tsaritsa!; or By using Windborne Sword·: Transpose in the Constellation Unwavering Ardor. Radiance: Stellar Swirl: DMG dealt by the Spirit Blades become Anemo DMG that is considered Stellar Swirl reaction DMG instead.

blocks.text: Banehunter Oathhammer: A witchhunter's trusty companion! Under the right conditions, the Banehunter Oathhammer undergoes Elemental Conversion, turning all its DMG into DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type. Prune can summon the Banehunter Oathhammer that has undergone Elemental Conversion in the following ways: For a certain time after triggering a Swirl Reaction on an opponent with the Elemental Skill Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime, Prune can unleash the special Elemental Skill Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes!. When using this special Elemental Skill, the Banehunter Oathhammer will be converted to the other Elemental Type involved in the aforementioned Swirl Reaction. After the Ascension Talent 'Verdict and Punishment' is unlocked, when the Witchlure Bell in Hunter-Seeker mode triggers Swirl on an opponent, it will summon a Banehunter Oathhammer that has undergone the corresponding Elemental Conversion to attack the opponent.

pairs: Holding on Sprint or Jump when Vesna is not in combat will cause her to enter the Coursing state. Coursing Continuously consumes Stamina to hover in mid-air. Sprinting or tapping Jump to go higher expends additional Stamina. Including the hold on Jump that triggers Coursing, Vesna can go higher up to 3 times in each instance of the Coursing state. Additionally, in Snezhnaya (excluding Nod-Krai), when Vesna is switched onto the field while the currently active party member is in mid-air and not in combat, she will immediately enter the Coursing state and regenerate 50 Stamina. This effect can trigger once every 10s, and does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.

Dawnbearing Songbird: Summons the trusty messenger bird, "Aedon." Different effects are produced depending on whether the skill is Tapped or Held. Tap Aedon dashes towards enemies in front, dealing Geo DMG to enemies it comes into contact with. Hold Enter aiming mode, and command Aedon to dash towards opponents being aimed at, dealing Geo DMG to opponents it comes into contact with.
Shadowless Reflection: Light the lamp, dealing AoE Geo DMG , and gain Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect for 20s. When this effect is active, Illuga gains 21 stacks of Nightingale's Song. It can increase the Geo DMG inflicted by current active characters. When Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts of nearby active party members deal Geo DMG to opponents, 1 stack of Nightingale’s Song is consumed to increase the DMG dealt. Increase in DMG is based on Illuga’s Elemental Mastery. If DMG is inflicted by Lunar-Crystallize, DMG dealt will increase further. When Geo DMG dealt in this manner hits multiple opponents, multiple stacks of Nightingale's Song will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit. Additionally, if there are Geo Constructs created by nearby party members on the battlefield while Illuga unleashes his Elemental Burst, or when nearby party members create Geo Constructs while Haunted Night's Oriole-Song is active, every Geo Construct on the battlefield will allow Illuga to gain 5 additional stacks of Nightingale's Song. Within 20s after unleashing his Elemental Burst, Illuga can gain a maximum of 15 additional stacks of Nightingale’s Song this way. When all stacks of Nightingale's Song have been consumed, or when the state's duration ends, the Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect will end.
Torchforger's Covenant: After unleashing Elemental Skill Dawnbearing Songbird or Elemental Burst Shadowless Reflection , other nearby party members will gain the Lightkeeper's Oath effect for 20s: For Geo DMG dealt to opponents, CRIT Rate increases by 5% and CRIT DMG increases by 10%. - Increased the maximum number of Artifacts stored in the Inventory from 2,400 to 2,700.
Quests:

- Adds a teleportation function for quest objectives: Some quest objective locations now support teleportation. Select a supported objective on the " Map " screen and click the "Go" button to teleport to the quest objective or a nearby location. (This feature initially applies to certain quests in the Version 7.0 update. Future versions expand support to more new quests and further optimize the feature.)
Enemies:

- Optimizes how attempts are counted for the related " Valiant Chronicles " challenge objective to: "Before the Prism Slime first gathers light and swells, make sure it attempts to absorb energy no more than 2 times," so that the count more accurately reflects the enemy's skill actions.
Exploration:

- Adjusts how Multi-Layered Maps are displayed on the " Map " screen to prevent the layouts of unexplored areas from being revealed prematurely and affecting the gameplay experience: A Multi-Layered Map and its corresponding button now appear only after the Traveler has reached or unlocked the relevant area (before this adjustment, Multi-Layered Maps were always visible). If the corresponding area contains a tracked point, including a tracked Teleport Waypoint, the Multi-Layered Map and its button remain visible.
- Optimizes the display logic when the " Luna Treasure Compass " and " Segment-Domain Treasure Compass " mark clues: Increases the display priority of Oculus icons to prevent them from being obscured by other icons. (The " Cryo Treasure Compass " introduced in Version 7.0 also incorporates this optimization.)
- Increases the pin limit on the Map from 300 to 350.
Adventurer Handbook:

- Optimizes the sorting logic on the " Domains " page of the Adventurer Handbook : All Domains are now consistently sorted based on the version in which they were added and their unlock status, with unlocked Domains from more recent versions appearing higher in the list.
Inventory:

- Increases the combined Inventory capacity for Character Development Items , Food , Materials , Gadgets , Quest Items , and Precious Items from 2,300 to 2,600.
- Increases the maximum number of Artifacts that can be stored in the Inventory from 2,400 to 2,700.
Audio:

- Optimizes the sound effects in certain scenes, interfaces, and quests.
- Optimizes Chinese and Japanese voice-over lines in certain quests.
Other:

- Adds gyroscope support for certain Android devices that do not have a magnetometer but support a gyroscope.
- Adjusts the visual effects of " Stellar-Conduct " and "Starlight Prism" when Graphics Quality is set to "Low" or "Lowest" to reduce performance load.
Genius Invokation TCG Balance Adjustment:

- Adjusts the number of Elemental Dice required and DMG dealt by the Elemental Skill of the Character Card " Ifa ": The Elemental Dice cost is adjusted from 2 Anemo Dice to 3, and the DMG dealt is adjusted from 1 Anemo DMG to 2 Anemo DMG.
- Adjusts the Radiant Hues enhancement effect "Radiant Hues: Swift Shadow" for the Elemental Skill of the Character Card " Wayward Hermetic Spiritspeaker ." Its effect is adjusted to: "When you play Radiant Hues: Grant a random highest-cost card in your Hand Cost Reduction equal to the number of stacks of this status."
- Adjusts the Elemental Skill effect of the Character Card "Wayward Hermetic Spiritspeaker": Effect changed to "Deal 1 Cryo DMG, and place 1 Radiant Hues third from the top of your deck. If this is one of the first 4 times this skill is being used this game, then select 1 of 3 random Radiant Hues enhancement effects."
- Adjusts the effects of " Tonatiuh ," a card generated by the Adventure effect. When Adventure Experience reaches 2, its effect is adjusted to "Draw 1 card." The DMG dealt by "Tide-Turning Sacred Lord" is adjusted to 3 Piercing DMG.
- Adjusts the effect of the Event Card " In Every House a Stove " when played in the first Round. Its effect is adjusted to: "If your deck initially contains at least 4/2 different Talent Cards, draw 2/1 Talent Cards."
Quests:

- Fixes an issue where, sometimes under certain circumstances, the character would be teleported to an incorrect location and end up falling in an endless loop during the objective "Flee from the spinning turbine" in the World Quest " Visitors From the Stars ."
Enemies:

- Fixes an issue where the visual effects for certain attacks performed by the enemy " Ruin Hunter " would display incorrectly.
- Fixes an issue where the camera would behave abnormally when Sandrone used her Elemental Skill while the enemy Millennial Pearl Seahorse 's Xenomare Pearl was damaged.
- Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, the enemy " Prism Slime " became stuck underground when disengaging from combat, with no way to reset its state.
- Fixes an issue whereby there is a chance that the enemy " Moosh-Tehir " behaves abnormally when using skills.
- Fixes an issue whereby the enemy " Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network " is unaffected by characters' taunting skills.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, there is a small chance that Detection Devices deployed by the enemy "Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network" disappear unexpectedly.
Characters:

- Fixes an issue where, when Sandrone's Charged Attack was canceled and she changed direction, some of Fagio 's skill effects would also follow her new orientation in error.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, there is a chance that the animation for the first hit of Sandrone's Normal Attack stutters abnormally when she performs consecutive Normal Attacks.
- Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, the Elemental RES reduction effect of Venti 's Constellation 6 would sometimes not take effect.
- Fixes an issue whereby, after Citlali equips the outfit " Whispers of Stars and Smoke ," Citlalin's movement trajectory becomes abnormal when the Jump button is held to perform a leap.
- Fixes an issue whereby, following the Version Luna VIII update, there is a chance that the shield generated by Diona 's Elemental Skill has an abnormal duration.
- Fixes an issue whereby there is a chance that the ribbon on Aether 's outfit " As Heaven and Earth Are Made Anew " clips through his hair.
- Fixes an issue whereby there is a chance that the ribbons on Lumine 's outfits "As Heaven and Earth Are Made Anew" and "Rising Star" clip through her character model.
- Fixes an issue whereby, on mobile devices, certain lighting effects are missing from Lohen 's Elemental Burst animation.
- Fixes an issue whereby, in Co-Op Mode , when multiple Travelers are each using Yae Miko and have unlocked the Talent " Edict of Cleansing ," there is a chance that enhanced Sesshou Sakura lightning strikes fail to trigger the additional Electro DMG provided by the "Radiance: Stellar-Conduct" effect upon hitting enemies.
- . Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, after Cyno unlocks the Additional Talent " A Star With Which to Start the Journey ," there is a chance that an abnormal number of Elemental Particles are generated when his Elemental Skill hits an enemy.
- . Fixes an issue whereby abnormal visual effects remain in Illuga 's hands after he uses his Elemental Skill by holding the Skill button.
Audio:

- Fixes an error in the Chinese voice-over for the dialogue option "How do you like it here?" when interacting with Sandrone in the Serenitea Pot .
- Fixes an error in a voice-over line in the Archon Quests " As All Falls to Emptiness " and " Ancient Shadows Re-Emerge ."
- Fixes an issue where, following the Version "Luna VIII" update, the Chinese voice-over for certain lines was missing from Yelan 's Travelers' Tales .
- Restores certain related voice-over lines that were missing whenever Columbina performed the first hit of her Normal Attack.
Miliastra Wonderland:
- Fixes an issue whereby, when using a keyboard and mouse on PC, there is a chance that some key inputs fail to register if multiple keys are pressed simultaneously in Miliastra Wonderland stages.
Serenitea Pot:

- Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, characters would clip into the furnishing " Ripples in Miniature ."
- Fixes an issue where the model of the furnishing " Keys of Ingenuity " was inconsistent with its icon and the model displayed in the " Sunny Summer Fontinalia " event.
System:

- Fixes an issue whereby certain settings changes made while playing " Repertoire of Myriad Melodies " are not saved after logging back in.
- Fixes an issue whereby character facial shading displays abnormally on the " Character " screen.
- Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, the Element of the Traveler was displayed incorrectly in the "Challenge Record" screen during Stygian Onslaught gameplay.
- Fixes an issue on mobile devices where, after using a controller to navigate from the " Settings " to the "Pre-Install" screen, players were then unable to exit the corresponding screen.
- Fixes an issue in certain screens or scenes where switching to characters wearing their new outfits (specifically Citlali's "Whispers of Stars and Smoke" and Charlotte's "Hurlock Variations") might occasionally cause minor lags.
- Fixes an issue in the "Equipment" and Weapon > Enhance screens where the weapon " Ballad of the Fjords " would display with an incorrect height.
Other:

- Fixes an issue in Imaginarium Theater whereby, when the duration of certain stacks of the Brilliant Blessing "Bloom: Core Condensation" expires, there is a chance that all stacks are incorrectly cleared.
- Fixes text errors in certain quests, interfaces, dialogues and descriptions.
- Fixes an issue whereby the gadget " Sandrone's Portable Tea Table " can be placed inside the Knights of Favonius Headquarters when it should not be.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, when selecting "Send Invitation" while using the gadget "Sandrone's Portable Tea Table," there is a chance that the "Cancel Quest" button is also activated.
- Fixes an issue where the gadget "Sandrone's Portable Tea Table" could be placed while clipping through terrain and locations.
- Fixes an issue whereby, on certain mobile devices or on PCs with Graphics Quality set to "Low" or "Lowest," certain particle effects persist abnormally after Sandrone uses a Charged Attack.
- Fixes some text errors in certain languages and optimizes text. (Note: Related in-game functions have not changed. Travelers can view the changes in different languages by going to the Paimon Menu > Settings > Language and changing the Game Language.) Optimizes inconsistencies between certain voice-overs and the corresponding lines. Optimizes certain English translations.
- Optimizes inconsistencies between certain voice-overs and the corresponding lines.
- Optimizes certain English translations.

- Currently, in a cutscene for the Archon Quest " Wraith's Nocturne ," the Elemental Type icon displayed for Mitya appears incorrect (it should be an Electro " Stellar Linchpin "). This issue will be fixed in a future update.
- Currently, PC devices equipped with Intel® Iris® Xe series graphics cards may experience abnormal screen flickering when entering the Snezhnaya region. Travelers who encounter this issue are advised to visit the Intel official website to download and install the latest graphics driver, then restart their device to resolve the issue. Travelers can also visit the following link for detailed instructions on updating Intel drivers: https://www.hoyolab.com/article/20981435
- Currently, certain Landrover and Fatui Oprichniki opponents can still fire their weapons while Frozen or Petrified (including in the Spiral Abyss , the open world, Shadow Realms , etc.). This issue will be fixed in the Version 7.1 update.

- Fixes an issue in the " Test Run " event where the description related to Stellar-Conduct reactions contained errors. The incorrect text read: "...the [Polestar] field will store the dissipating elemental energies and then completely release them every 3s. This further increases the aforementioned DMG Bonus and also increases the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG coefficient for 3s." Fixed text: "...the [Polestar] field will store the dissipating elemental energies and then completely release them every 4s. This further increases the aforementioned DMG Bonus and also increases the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG coefficient for 4s."

- Adds an additional location of Prime Ice that can be repeatedly demolished in the scene for the objective "Use Prime Ice Constructs to prop up the door" in the Archon Quest " Everwinter Without Mercy " to resolve the issue whereby, under certain circumstances, there would be no Prime Ice available to demolish within the area, preventing Travelers from obtaining Prime Ice Resource and progressing the quest.
- Fixes an issue on some Android devices whereby abnormal patterns would appear on the faces of Sandrone and Mitya during certain dialogues in the Archon Quests "Everwinter Without Mercy" and " Wraith's Nocturne ."
- Fixes an issue whereby, after completing the World Quest " Variations on Belyi and Chernyi " with Traveler ( Lumine ) and unlocking the ending "Lost Amidst the Applause," Traveler (Lumine) would incorrectly appear as Traveler ( Aether ) in the image inside the quest item " Black Snow Swan Archive ." Travelers affected by the above issues can log out via the Paimon Menu by selecting "Exit to Login Interface" and close the game, then log in again to resolve the issues.
- Fixes an issue whereby the display density of Prime Ice Constructs is abnormally high in certain areas of Snezhnaya .
- Reduces the frequency at which "Sign: Icon" and "Sign: Text" are pushed for all types of Prime Ice Constructs. *Effective time of the above changes: If a Traveler has not logged into the game between 2026/08/13 05:00 and 2026/08/13 23:13, the changes will take effect immediately upon their next login. If a Traveler has logged into the game during the specified period, the changes will take effect when they log in again after 2026/08/14 05:00.

- Fixes an issue whereby the "Decorate Carriage" and "Remove Decoration" options for the train summoned by the Eye of Graeae became available before completing the World Quest " Daybreak After the Snow ." After this fix, any decorations set before completing the quest remain unaffected. The relevant options no longer appear before the World Quest is completed and become available again after completion.
- Fixes an issue on mobile devices whereby, under certain circumstances, performing a slide during the Archon Quests " Everwinter Without Mercy " and " Gunfire in the Silent Lands " caused display abnormalities and prevents further operation.
- Fixes an issue whereby the weapon of Odette appeared in an incorrect position after she performed a Charged Attack.
- Fixes an issue on some mobile devices whereby, with Graphics Quality set to "Lowest," the eyes of Traveler ( Aether ) and Traveler ( Lumine ) displayed incorrectly during certain quest dialogues.
- Fixes some display issues with the Traveler character model on mobile devices, including issues with Aether's earring and Lumine's top.
- Fixes an issue when playing via Genshin Impact · Cloud whereby settings changed under Eye of Graeae > Settings > Controls > Third-Person Shooter reverted to default after re-entering the game.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, the relevant chest did not appear after completing the challenge offered by the NPC " Lukov " in Fellfrost Peak , Snezhnaya . Travelers who encounter this issue can return to the vicinity of the challenge location and use the Cryo Treasure Compass to locate the chest.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, characters may be unable to enter cover, and the behavior of some enemies may become abnormal in "Edge of Survival" stages.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, the camera may behave abnormally after challenging the " Immortal Construct " or " Chimeric Winged Lion " in the open world.
- Fixes an issue on the Irminsul server whereby tags displayed incorrectly on the "Top Comments" screen of Miliastra Wonderland stages.
- Fixes an issue in Miliastra Wonderland whereby, after switching to the "Wonderland Rising Stars" tab from another screen, Travelers were unable to swipe down to refresh and load more new stages.
- Fixes localization errors in some Indonesian, Korean, Japanese, English, and Russian text. In English, this includes an issue in the Archon Quest "Everwinter Without Mercy" whereby some personal pronouns were incorrect.
Travelers affected by the above issues can log out via the Paimon Menu by selecting "Exit to Login Interface" and close the game, then log in again to resolve the issues.
- Fixes an issue whereby the playtime of some Travelers was displayed abnormally in the "Top Comments" section of Miliastra Wonderland stages.

- Due to the fixes released in the August 20 update for the issues on mobile devices whereby the Traveler character model had been partially displayed incorrectly and the eyes of the Traveler character model had been displayed incorrectly during certain quest dialogues, a new issue causing the Traveler to disappear abnormally during " Mistilteinn " in the Archon Quest was introduced. The relevant fixes have been reverted. The aforementioned display issues will be fixed separately in a future update.

- Updates resources related to subsequent events.
- Fixes an issue whereby some Aranara in Vanarana displayed abnormal colors after completing the Aranyaka Quest series.
- Fixes an issue whereby shader compilation would be repeatedly triggered on some Android devices.
- Fixes an issue whereby the statue on the west side of the royal hall had a small chance of disappearing abnormally during the World Quest " The Stone Beasts, Like Ghouls Seated " while on the quest objective "Find a way to open the door to the royal hall."
- Fixes an issue whereby the game camera had a small chance of behaving abnormally after battling Pavlina in the World Quest " Bell Ringing at Dusk ."
- Fixes an issue in certain circumstances where Manekin models with abnormal appearances would occasionally appear in the Public Lobby of Miliastra Wonderland on some devices.
- Adjusts the scene rendering for Snezhnograd : slightly increases the loading distance for high-precision models to improve the display quality of distant scenery models.
- Applies to: PC, console, and mobile devices with the default Environment Detail setting set to High or Highest. *Travelers using the aforementioned mobile devices who have manually changed "Environment Detail" under " Settings / Graphics" will need to adjust it to "High" or "Highest" for the changes to take effect.
Travelers experiencing the issue mentioned above can resolve it by selecting "Exit to Login Interface" from the Paimon Menu, closing the game, and then logging in again.

- Genshin Impact has added support for Pixel 11 series devices following compatibility updates from the manufacturer. Travelers using the relevant devices are advised to head to the Google Play Store to update the game. You will be able to play normally once the update is complete. *Devices featuring early PowerVR GE, GM, or Rogue series architectures remain unsupported by the game at this point. This update is a dedicated optimization for the Pixel 11 and requires no action from Travelers on other devices.

- Fixes an issue in " Edge of Survival " (third-person shooter combat gameplay) where in-game time could be paused via the Mail system, thereby affecting score calculation.
- Fixes an issue in the stage "Frigid Storm" of "Edge of Survival" (third-person shooter combat gameplay) whereby the enemy "Ever-Lingering Illusion" could be abnormally defeated repeatedly, affecting score calculation.

* The development team will continue to monitor the exploitation of game bugs for score gains. Further fixes for similar issues will roll out in upcoming updates, and any records on the Frontrunners' Edge page obtained through these exploits will be invalidated.

- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances in " Shadow Realm " (the third-person shooter combat mode), the effects of the firearm " Balsag's Sunwheel " do not match its description (for example, other firearms may incorrectly receive the full-loadout effects of "Balsag's Sunwheel").
- Fixes an issue in "Shadow Realm" (third-person shooter combat gameplay) whereby the full-loadout effects of the firearm "Balsag's Sunwheel" could sometimes fail to take effect.

Quests:

- Adjusts the collision volumes of certain scene objects in the Archon Quests " Everwinter Without Mercy " and " Wraith's Nocturne " to fix an issue whereby characters might abnormally clip through objects or become unable to move.
Enemies:

- Optimizes the landing point selection logic for the Rugged Elder Leshy 's leap attack. The landing point is now determined based on the target's position when it jumps, rather than the target's real-time position.
Exploration:

- Optimizes touchscreen interactions for the button used to build Prime Ice Constructs in the open world to reduce accidental inputs: Now, after pressing the button on a touchscreen, Travelers must release their touch within the button area to open the corresponding interface.
- Adjusts the height of the snowball tunnel in an open-world Time Trial Challenge south of the Domain " Inverted Glacier " in Snezhnaya to prevent snowballs from breaking apart during the Challenge.
Audio:

- Optimizes the trigger frequency of the voice lines for certain enemies when hit.
- Adds communicator sound effects to Katheryne 's voice lines when contacting her via the Prime Ice Communicator.
- Optimizes Chinese and Japanese voice-over lines in certain quests, and fixes related voice-over errors.
Prime Ice Construct:

- Optimizes interactions with Prime Ice Constructs during combat: Players can no longer like a Prime Ice Construct, activate or remove a Starlight Prism, or open a Storage Device.
- When using a keyboard and mouse or a controller, switching between Prime Ice Constructs in the "Build Prime Ice Construct" interface now loops: Switching to the previous construct from the first construct will loop to the last, and vice versa.
- In touchscreen mode, moving characters will no longer stop immediately upon opening the "Build Prime Ice Construct" interface.
Miliastra Wonderland:

- Adjusts the weekly missions for the " Miliastra Wonderland " Miliastra Pass from "Complete 5/10/15 matches," with each mission awarding 1,000 Chronicle EXP , to "Complete 5 matches or play for 20 minutes," "Complete 10 matches or play for 40 minutes," and "Complete 15 matches or play for 60 minutes," each of which awards 1,000 Chronicle EXP.
Other Systems:

- Optimizes the sorting logic in the "Change Avatar > Avatar Frame " screen: Unlocked Avatar Frames now appear higher in the list.
- The " Adventurer Handbook > Guide" interface now includes guidance for quests related to " Witch's Revelation ."
Other:

- Optimizes the movement of Lohen 's cape when jumping and falling, making it appear more natural.
- Reduces the interaction range of the "Observe" option on the display table in the train to reduce accidental interactions.
- Optimizes certain stage layouts for Xiao 's Challenge within Envisaged Echoes .
- Adds a new Teleport Waypoint to Fellfrost Peak in Snezhnaya following the addition of a new boss enemy. (The number of Teleport Waypoints required to unlock the achievement "Icebound Snowscape (I)" has been adjusted accordingly. Travelers who have already completed this achievement will retain their completion status.)
- After this version update, if your party includes a character who can locate Snezhnaya Local Specialties , their locations will be displayed on the mini-map while in the Shadow Realm (Third-Person Shooter Combat Gameplay).
- Optimizes the resolution calculation logic for certain Android and HarmonyOS devices, improving resolution performance on affected devices (Travelers can adjust their graphics settings based on their device's actual condition to balance visual quality and performance).

- Character Card: Navia 's Passive Skill " Mutual Assistance Network ," Jahoda 's Passive Skill " Moonsign Benediction: Rooftop Dash ," Azhdaha 's Elemental Skill " Aura of Majesty ," Mona 's Talent Card " Prophecy of Submersion ," Neuvillette 's Talent Card " Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority ," and Aino 's Talent Card " The Burden of Creative Genius ."
Quests:

- Fixes an issue during the Archon Quest " Everwinter Without Mercy " whereby the Traveler 's weapon is displayed incorrectly while completing the quest objective "Use the power of Cryo on the Statue of The Seven."
- Fixes an issue in the cutscene of the Archon Quest " Wraith's Nocturne " where Mitya 's Elemental Type icon was displayed incorrectly (it should be the Electro Stellar Linchpin ).
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, clearing cracked ice near the quest area before accepting the World Quest " Ever Beneath the Waves " prevents the quest from progressing.
- Fixes an issue whereby dialogue related to the World Quest " The Many Matters Learned in One's Travels " could be incorrectly triggered when contacting Katheryne using the Prime Ice Communicator .
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, the dog might fail to move during the "Follow the dog" objective in the World Quest " Daybreak After the Snow ," preventing quest progression.
- Fixes an issue whereby the camera would behave abnormally during the "Leap into the crater" objective in the World Quest " Nahuatzin's Leap ."
- Fixes an issue whereby the ribbons on the Traveler's outfit would clip through the character model during certain dialogues or cutscenes in the Third-Person Shooter Combat Gameplay sequences featured in some World Quests.
Enemies:

- Fixes an issue whereby the special effects of the Ice Coffin might persist abnormally after defeating the Snegovik .
- Fixes an issue where the animation duration of the Wind Current generated by the enemy Churin did not match its actual duration.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, the enemy Churldric would continue accumulating cooking progress over time after you extinguished the bonfire beneath the Delicious Hot Pot it summoned.
- Fixes an issue whereby the HP icon for the enemy "Sharpshooter" was displayed incorrectly in the area north of the Everfrozen Earth in Snezhnaya.
- Fixes an issue whereby the enemy " Rugged Elder Leshy " could unexpectedly disengage from combat at certain locations in Flamefeather Valley in Snezhnaya.
- Fixes an issue where, when Graphics Quality was set to "Lowest," the warning range for some skills of the enemy " Zhara " in the World Quest " In the Dwelling of Life " would not display.
- Fixes an issue where some " Landcruiser " and " Fatuus Oprichniki " units would continue to shoot while in the Frozen or Petrification state.
- Fixes an issue whereby after the Ice Coffin of the opponents " Glaciomancer " and " Glacial Warden " was affected by Stellar Glimmer reactions , the efficiency of using Pyro and Geo attacks to break said Ice Coffin would be abnormal.
Characters:

- Fixes an issue whereby the Elemental Skill CD Reduction effect of Qiqi 's Additional Talent " Seven Sacred Treasures " could occasionally fail to take effect.
- Fixes an issue whereby the Elemental Mastery provided by Beidou 's Constellation Lv. 6 " Radiance: Stellar-Conduct " could occasionally fail to take effect.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, the eyes of the Cryo Traveler Lumine might display minor visual abnormalities when casting her Elemental Burst after switching to the outfit " As Heaven and Earth Are Made Anew ."
- Fixes an issue whereby the waist sash on Odette 's outfit might abnormally clip through while performing Normal Attacks or climbing.
Weapons:
- Fixes an issue whereby the icon for the weapon " Prospector's Drill " was incorrect and did not match its model.
Exploration:

- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, the challenge offered by NPC " Zharkaya " in Svetloledovka , Snezhnaya cannot be completed normally.
- Fixes an issue whereby the "Catch the Jack Frosts Challenge" at the " House of Hesperides " in Snezhnaya contains text errors.
- Fixes an issue whereby using Nicole's Charged Attack outside of combat fails to locate chest clues related to Tribal Challenges.
- Fixes an issue in an open-world puzzle in Everfrozen Earth, Snezhnaya, whereby a "Prime Ice Cloud Platform" can be abnormally pushed by character skills.
- Fixes an issue whereby entering the "Prime Ice Construct: Snowball Launcher" while taking a heat source prevents the launcher from firing.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, the character's Movement SPD could become abnormal after falling from the train .
- Fixes an issue whereby certain Character Switching Effects would be missing when switching characters on the Train.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, the Time Trial Challenge offered by the NPC Vershina in House of Hesperides in Snezhnaya could not be started.
- Fixes an issue where the Quest Item " Key of Ancient Design " was not removed from the Inventory after being consumed during gameplay. Travelers affected by this issue can head to the relevant gameplay area in the House of Hesperides in Snezhnaya, where the remaining item will be automatically consumed.
- . Fixes an issue in the open world where Crystalflies near the enemy " Chimeric Winged Lion " would be startled by lightning strikes.
Audio:

- Fixes issues with sound effects and music in certain quests, environments, objects, gameplay modes, and interfaces, and optimizes the related audio experience.
- Fixes an issue with the voice lines of the enemy " Mirror Maiden " in the open world.
Prime Ice Construct:

- Fixes an issue whereby Travelers who had not unlocked a specific Prime Ice Construct appearance could not manage a construct with that appearance via the "Manage Prime Ice Constructs" interface after receiving it in the open world.
- Fixes an issue whereby the "Prime Ice Construct: Cube" would automatically switch to a newly unlocked appearance.
- Fixes an issue whereby Klee 's Elemental Skill could abnormally remove Prime Ice Constructs.
Third-Person Shooter Combat Gameplay:

- Fixes an issue in the Shadow Realm (Third-Person Shooter Combat gameplay) where the attack height of " Frag Crystal - Hydro " was abnormal.
- Fixes an issue in the "Formation Breaker" and "Close-Quarter Frenzy" stages of " Edge of Survival " (third-person shooter combat gameplay) whereby elite icons are missing next to the HP bars of certain elite enemies.
- Fixes an issue in the Shadow Realm (Third-Person Shooter Combat gameplay) where certain enemies could behave abnormally under specific circumstances (such as when an enemy's route changed or when they disengaged from combat).
- Fixes an issue whereby certain enemies had incorrect levels in Shadow Realm "Maintenance Center" (Third-Person Shooter Combat gameplay).
- Fixes an issue whereby characters could no longer sprint after performing a slide while holding a Frag Crystal in the Shadow Realm (Third-Person Shooter Combat Gameplay) when using keyboard and mouse or controller.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, the firearm " Ashamez's Thunder " could deal incorrect DMG to wards in the Shadow Realm (Third-Person Shooter Combat Gameplay).
- Fixes an issue whereby the active character would briefly disappear after opening and closing the viewing screen for the Gadget " Eye of Graeae ."
Miliastra Wonderland:

- Fixes an issue whereby the acquisition animation would play incorrectly when obtaining a 5-star Cosmetic in Gifting Mode.
- Fixes an issue whereby the Cosmetic " Butterfly Resplendence Pinned Hair (Hairstyle)" would display incorrectly when hair locks were hidden.
- Fixes an issue whereby the pattern on the soles of the shoes in the Cosmetic Set: Whimsical Spectacle was displayed incorrectly.
- Fixes an issue whereby the leg accessories would display incorrectly when paired with the Cosmetic "Twilight Phantom Thief Long Boots (Footwear)."
- Fixes an issue whereby adjusting the Cosmetic " Azure Mountainshade Kamera (Ornament)" would display incorrectly.
- Fixes an issue whereby, when another Traveler's Manekin/Manekina sat down in the Lobby , the skirt of their Cosmetics would appear differently on other clients than on their own client.
- Fixes an issue whereby the eyes of the Manekin wearing the Cosmetic Set: Whimsical Spectacle would display incorrectly when performing the "Colorful Entrance" action.
- Fixed an issue on iOS devices where opening the "Popular Miliastra Wonderland > Genius Column" interface would occasionally cause an abnormal crash.
Serenitea Pot:

- Fixes an issue whereby the model for Red Beets planted in the Serenitea Pot was displayed incorrectly.
- Fixes an issue whereby the icons for the materials " White Birch Wood " and " Snow Poplar Wood " were incorrect.
- Fixes an issue whereby the model for the Furnishing " Party Standee: 'Popular Idol' " was incorrect and inconsistent with the related character.
Other Systems:

- Fixes an issue on the Character screen whereby Odette 's skirt experiences minor clipping during idle animations.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, interface effects would display incorrectly when adding Traveler (Cryo) to a party via the Party Setup screen while in Snezhnaya .
- Fixes an issue on the "Quest Overview > Guiding Notes " screen whereby the portraits for " The Jester " and Ronova are displayed incorrectly.
- Fixes an issue whereby certain text for the Archon Quest " Wraith's Nocturne " was displayed incorrectly in the Travel Log.
- Fixes an issue where the respawn timer for Aberrant Chimeric Monsters would display incorrectly after defeating all tracked targets via the Adventurer Handbook.
- Fixes an issue whereby the "Probability of Randomly Refunding Materials" prompt would not appear when selecting Yae Miko or Brunn to craft Character Talent Materials at a Crafting Bench .
- Fixes an issue whereby, after logging in using keyboard and mouse, the Reshape button would not display its keyboard shortcut when opening the " Artifacts > Reshape" screen for the first time.
Other:

- Fixes an issue whereby DMG dealt by the Stellar Swirl reaction could occasionally fail to include Cryo characters involved in the reaction in its calculations.
- Fixes an issue whereby controller vibration feedback would not trigger when Traveler (Cryo) used their Elemental Burst.
- Fixes an issue whereby, with the Seed Dispensary equipped, the interaction button would incorrectly display the corresponding seeds when opening chests containing certain Local Specialties from Snezhnaya .
- Fixes an issue whereby the dialogue options "Dispatch Character on Expedition" and "Check Valiant Chronicles information" appeared in the wrong order when speaking with Katheryne in Snezhnaya.
- Fixes an issue in Imaginarium Theater where the interruption effect of the Brilliant Blessing "Frostsquall: Extreme Coldseal" was abnormal.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, the achievement " Radio Silence " cannot be completed.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, the Traveler reverts to Anemo after logging back into the game despite having resonated with another element.
- Fixes an issue whereby certain objects and scenes display abnormally.
- Fixes text errors in certain quests, interfaces, dialogues, and descriptions.
- Fixes some text errors in certain languages and optimizes text. (Note: Related in-game functions have not changed. Travelers can view the changes in different languages by going to the Paimon Menu > Settings > Language and changing the Game Language.)

- Optimizes certain English translations.
- Optimizes certain English translations.

- Currently, an English voice-over line in the cutscene for the "One Move Left to Make" in the Archon Quest " White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking " contains errors that do not match the text, including an incorrect pronoun. This issue will be fixed in a future update.

- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, Travelers were unable to indwell the Koholasaurus within the Domain in " Black Feathers Scattered at Parting " of the Archon Quest " A Rekviem for the Underworld ," preventing quest progression.
- Optimizes the hint text for the "walkie-talkie" gameplay during the objective "Sneak into the vault" in " One Move Left to Make " of the Archon Quest " White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking ," making the related guidance clearer. The hint has been adjusted to: "Aim at an enemy within the blue boundary, then use the walkie-talkie."
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, some red notification dots on the "Events Overview" screen could not be cleared.
- Fixes an issue whereby there is a localization error in English, Turkish, Italian, and German for the description of Vodyanitsa 's Elemental Skill " Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn ." Before: "... the party's currently active character gains increased resistance to interruption ..." After: "... your active character gains increased resistance to interruption ..."
Travelers affected by the above issues can log out via the Paimon Menu by selecting "Exit to Login Interface" and close the game, then log in again to resolve the issues.
- Optimizes the sorting of certain events in the "Events Overview" interface.
- Updates resources related to subsequent events.

Genius Invokation TCG Balance Adjustment:

- Adjusts the activation mechanism of the "Discard" effect. Players can no longer preview the outcome after related "Discard" effects are triggered. Affected cards include: "Bonecruncher's Energy Block," "Qucusaurus," "Portable Power Saw," "Prospector's Drill," "The Dockhand's Assistant," "Conductor's Top Hat," "Flying Squad, Attack!," Chasca's Event Card "Shadowhunt Shell," and the skill of Character Cards "Lord of Eroded Primal Fire" and "Xinyan."
- Adjusts the effect of Chasca 's Event Card "Shadowhunt Shell": The trigger condition has been changed from "when this card is played or you Discard it" to "when this card is played or you Discard it from your Hand."
- Adjusts the activation mechanism of Food Event Cards with healing effects: They can now target Character Cards that are already at full health.
- Adjusts the effect of the Combat Status "Deep Devourer's Domain" of the Character Card " All-Devouring Narwhal ": The effect has been changed from "cards you have Discarded or used for Tune will be consumed" to "cards you have Discarded or used for Tune from your Hand will be consumed."
- Adjusts the effect of "Dark Shadow" summoned by Character Card "All-Devouring Narwhal": The effect that was previously triggered during "End Phase and when you declare the end of your Round", will now only be triggered during "End Phase."

- Fixes an issue that may have caused the Trial items absorbed via kuuvahki to display abnormally in the Domain of Archon Quest " Reunion Beneath the Moonlight ", blocking interaction and halting quest progress.
- Fixes an issue where, under specific circumstances, the Finch would vanish abnormally when interacting with the Rippleweed while completing the objective "Use kuuvahki to aid the trapped Finch" in Archon Quest " Where the Moon Rises ," halting quest progress.
- Fixes an issue whereby the Elemental Type indicated by the Traveler 's appearance during dialogue in the Archon Quest " A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves " did not match the Traveler's actual Elemental Type.
- Fixes an issue whereby claiming the Daily Commission rewards from "Katheryne" in regions outside of Mondstadt would block players from completing the World Quest " Every Day a New Adventure " upon returning to Mondstadt.
- Fixes an issue under certain circumstances whereby the Traveler could not complete the quest objective "Investigate the nearby area" during the World Quest " Crimson Cleansing ," thereby blocking further quest progress.
- Fixes an issue in the World Quest " The Tale-Telling Heart " whereby, after completing the objective "Collect Stellafruit, deliver them to Sergeant Octopus, and pass the trial," there was a small chance the related chest may not appear. After the update, Travelers who experienced this issue can return to the chest's original location to find it appearing correctly.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, some camera effects would incorrectly remain after completing the World Quest " The Special Support Squad's Tale ."

- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, there was a small chance that the enemy " Cutting Edge All-Purpose Scout Landcruiser " could behave abnormally.

- Fixes an issue whereby the enemy "Local Legend: Sigurd" would become immobilized and repeatedly dash and flicker after entering certain areas.
- Fixes an issue whereby the enemy " Frost Operative " was unable to correctly use counterattack skills after the Version 5.7 update.

- Fixes an issue where the dice would not display along the trail created by Yelan 's Elemental Skill under "Low" or "Lowest" graphic settings.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under specific circumstances, Yelan could either repeatedly perform charged attacks at an unintended rate or be unable to perform them at all.
- Fixes an issue in Co-Op Mode where the glowing effect of Lauma 's antlers on the Guest's screen would not display properly.
- Fixes an issue in Co-Op Mode whereby a Lauma with her Lv. 6 Constellation activated could not correctly consume "Pale Hymn" stacks granted by other Travelers' Laumas when using Normal Attacks.
- Fixes an issue whereby, after activating Lauma's Lv. 6 Constellation, the "Pale Hymn" effect could incorrectly remain active in certain cases even after its stacks dropped to 0.
- Fixes an issue whereby the character model of Flins would display abnormally while jumping.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under specific circumstances, characters would abnormally retain their underwater pose after teleporting to land.
Equipment:
- Fixes an issue whereby, the 4-Piece Set effects of " Bloodstained Chivalry " would not be triggered when an enemy was defeated by certain characters' consecutive Charged Attacks.

- Fixes an issue with Character Card " Sigewinne " where the passive effect of its passive skill "Detailed Diagnosis, Thorough Treatment" would not activate after being defeated and revived.
- Fixes an issue whereby the Support Card "Masters of the Night-Wind" had a chance to incorrectly generate a 3-cost Support Card "Grand Narukami Shrine" instead of a Support Card with a cost of 2 Elemental Dices.
- Fixes an issue whereby, after the Character Card " Furina " equipped " Splendor of Tranquil Waters " and gained the "Center of Attention" status, her Normal Attacks could occasionally fail to trigger the Weapon Card's effect.

- Fixes an issue that would cause the Progress Bar of Party Character Power in the Training Guide interface to display incorrectly.
- Fixes an issue that prevented non-Chinese scores from being counted in the Performance Overview of the profile page in Repertoire of Myriad Melodies.

- Fixes an issue whereby expired " Transient Resin " was incorrectly counted as consumption of " Original Resin ."

- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances in Imaginarium Theater , the same combat event could incorrectly appear twice when challenging Lunar Mode.

- Fixes an issue whereby certain animations and sound effects for the furnishing " Chic Badger " were not synchronized.

- There is an issue whereby some sound effects are missing (including sound effects for certain skills of the characters Ganyu , Keqing , and Freminet ). This issue will be fixed in a future version.
- There is an issue whereby there is a small possibility of missing combat-related audio (such as character, enemy, or object sounds) on some mobile devices under high load conditions. Since this issue is related to device performance stability, optimizations will be made in Version "Luna III" after stability testing.
- There is an issue whereby when the enemy " Frostnight Herra " is in the "Gloomveiled" state, some Character Talent effects that cannot deal damage will abnormally accumulate "damage taken progress" during the "Gloomveiled" period. This issue will be fixed in a future version.
- There is an issue whereby when equipping headwear for a Manekina with the " Candlelit Wizard: Pumpkin Candy " cosmetic, the bun hairstyle displays an abnormal hair color if "Hide Back of Hair" is selected in the component adjustment settings. This issue will be fixed in a future version.

- Fixes an issue whereby the event page could not automatically retrieve the corresponding account information when accessing the web event through the " Invitation to Wonderland: A Curious Awakening " interface, preventing direct participation in the event.
- Fixes an issue whereby under specific operations, individual rewards in the " Miliastra Pass " interface had a small probability of displaying incorrect item icons.
- Fixes an issue with Miliastra Wonderland in the cloud game whereby the "Stage Template" and "Stage Details" interfaces incorrectly display a "Download" button (used for downloading save files to create Wonderlands).
- Fixes an issue whereby the " Lobby " and " Ode " interfaces in Miliastra Wonderland exhibited abnormal scene environment and color performance under specific circumstances.

- Fixes an issue in Miliastra Wonderland whereby, under specific circumstances, the Collection Template " Candlelit Nightwalk: Serene Soiree " would still incorrectly display as "Not yet obtained" on the "New Personal Lobby" screen, even after being obtained by unlocking Epic of the Realms.
- Fixes an issue in the "Shop" > " Paimon's Bargains " screen whereby the interface would display incorrectly when exchanging for Mora.
- Fixes an issue whereby the scoreboard on the Miliastra Wonderland stage results screen may fail to display data when certain Display Mode settings are enabled.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under specific circumstances, the first Lunar-Bloom reaction triggered during the second half of a Spiral Abyss challenge would not correctly contribute to the accumulation of Verdant Dew progress.
- Fixes an issue whereby there was a small chance that unexpected cards could randomly be generated during a Genius Invokation TCG duel.

- Fixes an issue with the "Stage Settlement" menu. When players opened other Wonderland videos through "Recommended Wonderland," returning to the "Stage Settlement" menu would cause menu components to disappear abnormally.
- Fixes an issue in the World Quest " For a Green Island... " whereby when carrying out the objective "Throw the fragment(s) at the stone" was required, the stone would unexpectedly disappear after reaching the quest location under certain circumstances, preventing the quest from continuing.
- Optimizes the combat experience in the Archon Quest " Echoes of Fate ."
Travelers affected by the above issues can log out via the Paimon Menu by selecting "Exit to Login Interface" and close the game, then log in again to resolve the issues.

- Fixes an issue whereby the " Friends " tab might display abnormally in the " Lobby > Invite Player" and "Party > Find Teammates" interfaces of Miliastra Wonderland under certain circumstances.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, Travelers on PlayStation®5 were unable to use the R2 button in Miliastra Wonderland stages.
- Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, the shadows of Wonderland Manekins might not display properly in the lobby of Miliastra Wonderland.
- Fixes an issue whereby, after viewing another Traveler's profile from the "Stage Details" screen in Miliastra Wonderland and returning to it, the colors of "Battle Records" would display abnormally.
- Fixes an issue whereby the "Friends" screen could behave abnormally when switching tabs using the left or right arrows with a mouse.
- Fixes an issue whereby functions assigned to the M key might not work properly when using keyboard and mouse controls.
- Fixes an issue whereby, when using keyboard and mouse controls, opening the Party Setup screen with a hotkey could cause the "Reading party info..." process to stop unexpectedly when the key was released under certain circumstances.
- Adds compatibility support for iPad Pro (M5) series devices.
Travelers affected by the above issues can log out via the Paimon Menu by selecting "Exit to Login Interface" and close the game, then log in again to resolve the issues.
- Updates the " Miliastra Wonderland " stage editor and Miliastra Sandbox content. Travelers can check the related update notice in "My Miliastra Wonderland" - "Notices."

- Adds compatibility support for 13-inch iPad Pro (M5).
- Updates resources related to subsequent events.
- Optimizes the red dot display logic for Miliastra Pass Weekly Quests in Miliastra Wonderland.

- Fixes an issue whereby after challenging the event " Dance Dance Dynamic Disco ," the game's open world music would sometimes disappear after returning to the open world. Travelers who encounter this issue can log out via the Paimon Menu by selecting "Exit to Login Interface" and close the game, then log in again to resolve the issue.
